segments.text: Ok so this is the Voice page for Google Antigravity, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page imports voice chat from a local file, and that file isn't on the page.
And uh, there's no install step for this voice package either.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part wasn't on the page, the voice chat file, so I had to add a placeholder myself.
Moving on to the demo. The voice page should load a voice chat, but it fails with module not found, and umm, it breaks the other routes too.
So basically, the page should give you working voice input, but the app doesn't even build, because the voice chat file is missing.
